Street furniture, storefronts, bridge structures, roofs, traffic, and landscaping are stylized.
Traffic simulation follows mapped road classes and one-way tags and uses illustrative signal timing.
Three.js is distributed under the MIT License. See THREE-LICENSE.txt.

CC0 model assets
Kenney Car Kit 3.1: https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit
Kenney City Kit Roads 2.2: https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-roads
Downloaded from the creator's OpenGameArt listings; original license files in assets/.
Selected OBJ meshes were converted to local vertex-colored geometry.
Belfort and Dirk Martens: user photo references, OSM footprint and https://inventaris.onroerenderfgoed.be/erfgoedobjecten/44
Grote Markt rosette: mapped grass footprint and user-supplied historic reference (classic layout).
